name: PowerShell Set-Acl On Windows Folder
description: Detects PowerShell scripts to set the ACL to a file in the Windows folder
author: GAI_CTI
query: ((process.pe.original_file_name:(PowerShell.EXE OR pwsh.dll)) OR (process.executable:(*\\powershell.exe OR *\\pwsh.exe))) AND (process.command_line:*Set\-Acl\ * AND process.command_line:*\-AclObject\ *) AND (process.command_line:(*\-Path\ \"C\:\\Windows* OR *\-Path\ 'C\:\\Windows* OR *\-Path\ %windir%* OR *\-Path\ $env\:windir*)) AND (process.command_line:(*FullControl* OR *Allow*))
